external_audit.decisive_finding: CDD reports 0.0% violations at every tau, but over VALID MOLECULES ONLY, and validity collapses 895->353 (~60%) at tau=3.0. Thm 4.1 is a contraction bound assuming beta-prox-regular C with guarantees claimed only for convex C, so the 0% is empirical not structural. Gradients come from a GPT-2 (124M) surrogate, not sascorer.
